issues: Real backtest (hunter · BTC · 3m + MC) did not complete within the 60s test cap in the preview (still in wizard-running state). Not a bug per spec ("real backtest may take 15-60s; if it times out that's acceptable"), but user-facing wait can feel long — consider a background progress ETA or partial-result streaming.

critical_code_review_comments: demo_seed.load_demo is well-scoped and idempotent — wipes 13 transient collections then seeds a deterministic (random.Random(1337)) set. Note: it wipes strategy_configs/strategy_meta/lab_runs unconditionally on every call; if a user has non-demo saved configs they will be lost. UX-safe today (owner-triggered) but consider a soft-merge or explicit confirmation on the frontend (the ws-demo card already says 'Overwrites current preview data. Preview only — not production.', which is good).

coach.py: APPLYABLE whitelist + clamp is correctly enforced both in weekly_review (sanitize before returning) and in coach_apply (validate_apply raising ValueError → 400). Emergent LLM key is read at call time, so rotating .env doesn't require restart.

coach.weekly_review persists every review into db.coach_reviews with a ts — good for audit; no PII concerns. However rec.suggested_value clamp uses `if isinstance(val, (int, float))` — a JSON number that comes back as a string would silently make it non-applyable rather than 4xx. Acceptable defensive behaviour; consider logging when this happens.
server.py demo_status route is public (no auth) — that's intentional (frontend uses it to show badge to anonymous visitors). Confirmed only returns counts/loaded booleans, no PII.

ResearchWizard.jsx uses STEPS.length = 5 for the stepper header (wizard-step-0..4) but the step body only has cases for step 0..3, with step 3 rendering the RUN button. This mismatch is intentional (step 4 = 'running' state) but slightly confusing — an inline comment near the STEPS array would help future maintainers.
TradingCoach.jsx correctly gates coach-generate-btn on `aiOn && isOwner` — matches the 'credits switch OFF by default' directive across all AI surfaces.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on iter29 spec (onboarding, ws-demo, ws-tour-replay, academy, wizard 5-step + advanced, coach full flow, metric-explainers, 5-tab regression, trade sub-tabs). Wizard real backtest is slow-running (unfinished in 60s) — acceptable per spec.
